geometry_edits.rationale: Introduce a real public void at the dominant mass so the street edge becomes legible and the neighborhood-living brief gains a usable ground response.
Open the carve toward the verified access side in the program frame.
Keep the void substantial enough to read across all views without hollowing the whole object.

graph_edits.rationale: Retarget the dominant mass toward a clearer public threshold by converting the final bend into a public void operator that can answer the access edge.
Align the opening with the verified access side in the program frame.
Carve a legible but compact void so the mass remains capacity-aware.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with a readable dominant stepped-to-bent gesture and no obvious view-to-view collisions. It fits the neighborhood-living brief only moderately well because the form is primarily an abstract terraced object; however, the non-rectangular footprint and the continuous bend give it enough massing intelligence to plausibly support compact mixed-use living. The main weakness is the street/public edge: the blue access edge is not convincingly answered by a carved court, seam, or entry void, so the ground response remains thin and semantically underdeveloped. The section is acceptable but somewhat neutral, with the terrace hierarchy doing more work than a true programmatic public threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than the neighborhood-living brief; borrow the sectional clarity, not the vertical scale.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/profiled massing with a clear dominant gesture and a restrained upper figure that still reads as one coherent object.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office-like atrium logic is stronger and more sealed at ground than this brief wants; adapt the void-to-entry relation, not the full composition.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A legible carved void can organize the mass and create a public threshold without destroying the overall block identity.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is much flatter and more single-story than the candidate; the canopy/sign logic is not directly transferable as massing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A calm horizontal datum with a selective vertical/accent element can support a small-scale neighborhood program.

warnings: Access edge response is weak relative to the verified frontage.
Void/publicness is the limiting concept; the mass reads more as a sculpted solid than a socially active ground figure.
If refined further, the next move should preserve the dominant stepped/bent body while carving a clearer entry/court toward the road edge.
